keyFindings.description: The INFRA-138 architect asked for this fix in this PR (21:20Z). A past version's comment link can land at the top of the page on first load. Cause, read in the code: ArtifactDocument.tsx:59-70 builds `highlight` as a new object on each render, and VersionView's effect lists `highlight` as a dependency (VersionView.tsx:119). So each parent render destroys the editor, builds a new one, and calls focusMark again. The tester traced 2-3 mounts per load, with the page collapsing to 720 px between them, and 2 misses in 45 chromium runs with a held diagram. Each remount also cancels the editor's draws, which can stop the worker while it draws. Fix: mount the version's editor once, for example by keying the effect on the highlight's id/quote/by and not on the object, or call focusMark after the final layout. Keep the tester's no-diagram row, and add a held-diagram row that checks the first landing. The reply-composer preventScroll change stays only if a row shows it is needed.
